title: 5.5 Likes, Dislikes, and Agreement
unit_outcome: Name fruit, food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, ask how many and how much, and order politely at a café.
goal: Express likes and dislikes, ask Do you like ...?, and agree with Me too. or Me neither.
grammar_function: I like coffee. Me too. I do not like milk. Me neither. Do you like coffee? Yes, I do.
prerequisite: 3.2 I; 1.8 not; 4.8 Do you...?; 5.1-5.3 fruit, food and drinks.
speaking_outcome: Say a preference and respond appropriately to positive or negative agreement.
